rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is a mandatory join key with 100% coverage required for referential integrity to Cust_Bio_dirty

rule: S_N must be unique across all records
rationale: S_N serves as a one-to-one join key; duplicate values (e.g., '3' appearing twice) indicate data quality issues

rule: Every S_N in Acc_Info_dirty must exist in Cust_Bio_dirty.S_N
rationale: Referential integrity required for one-to-one relationship between tables

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier with 0% missing rate observed

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Dominant observed format is 4 digits (derived from the data distribution). Values of different lengths are likely truncated, padded, or sentinel values.

rule: Account_No should be unique (allowing for valid business duplicates only)
rationale: Near-unique column with 2 repeated values (1001, 1010) that may indicate data entry errors unless multiple accounts per customer are valid

rule: Full_Name must not be null
rationale: Full_Name is a mandatory identity field with 0% missing rate

rule: Full_Name must be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Observed casing deviations: 'junrong', 'irfan', 'Hui Min tan', 'Lee yixuan' should be Title Case

check_params.logic: any((w[0].islower() or w.isupper()) and w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1 for w in str(row['Full_Name']).split())

rule: Full_Name must not contain leading, trailing, or double internal whitespace
rationale: Observed extra whitespace in 'Ramesh s/o  Govindasamy' (double space)

check_params.logic: '  ' in str(row['Full_Name']) or str(row['Full_Name']).startswith(' ') or str(row['Full_Name']).endswith(' ')

rule: ID must not be null
rationale: ID is a mandatory identification field with 0% missing rate

rule: ID must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S/T/F/G), 7 digits, one checksum letter
rationale: 96.7% of values follow format S1234567D; 3.3% deviate (e.g., 'S123456' with only 6 digits and no checksum)

rule: JoinDate must not be null
rationale: JoinDate is a mandatory temporal field with observed 3.3% missing rate (1 null value)

rule: JoinDate must be a parseable date string
rationale: Observed unparseable value '2025-13-01' (invalid month 13)

rule: JoinDate must not be in the future
rationale: JoinDate is a historical field; observed future date '2027-01-15' is invalid

rule: LastLogin must be a parseable date string
rationale: LastLogin is stored as string and must convert to datetime; all observed values currently parseable but validation required

rule: LastLogin must not be in the future
rationale: LastLogin is a historical activity timestamp; must not exceed current date

rule: Subscription_Type must be one of: Basic, Free, Gold, Platinum, Premium
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed valid tiers; no other values permitted

rule: SubscriptionFee must not be null
rationale: Observed 6.7% missing rate (2 null values) requires validation

rule: SubscriptionFee must be parseable as a number (or the literal 'free')
rationale: Column stored as string intended as float64; observed text value 'free' cannot be parsed as numeric

check_params.logic: not pd.isna(row['SubscriptionFee']) and pd.isna(pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce')) and str(row['SubscriptionFee']).lower() != 'free'

rule: SubscriptionFee must not contain sentinel placeholder values
rationale: Observed sentinel value '99999' used to represent missing/invalid data

rule: SubscriptionFee must be non-negative
rationale: Subscription fees represent monetary amounts and should not be negative

rule: Status must use the dominant boolean representations True or False
rationale: Boolean field stored as string with mixed representations; must be standardizable to bool

rule: AccountBalance must not contain sentinel placeholder 99999.0
rationale: Observed sentinel value 99999.0 appears sentinel-coded for missing/invalid data

rule: AccountBalance must not be negative unless representing valid overdraft
rationale: Observed negative value -150.5 is sign-anomalous in an account balance field; requires confirmation

rule: PreferredLanguage must be one of: English, French, German, Malay, Tamil
rationale: Categorical field with 5 observed valid language values

rule: Device must be one of: Desktop, Mobile, Tablet
rationale: Categorical field with 3 observed valid device types

rule: OS must be one of the canonical values: Android, iOS, Linux, Windows, macOS
rationale: Observed casing inconsistencies (LINUX, macOs, IOS, android) that deviate from official brand names

rule: FeedbackScore must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Observed outlier 7.3 exceeds expected 5-point scale; FeedbackScore1 confirms 5.0 maximum

rule: FeedbackScore1 must be between 1.0 and 5.0 inclusive
rationale: Consistent 1-5 rating scale observed; boundary validation required

rule: JoinDate must be on or before LastLogin
rationale: Logical temporal constraint: account creation must precede or equal last login activity

rule: When Subscription_Type is 'Free', SubscriptionFee must be 0, null, or the literal 'free'
rationale: Business logic: Free tier should not incur charges; observed violations where Free tier has numeric fees (e.g., 917.46, 99999)

check_params.logic: str(row['Subscription_Type']).lower() == 'free' and not (pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce') == 0 or pd.isna(pd.to_numeric(row['SubscriptionFee'], errors='coerce')) or str(row['SubscriptionFee']).lower() == 'free')

rule: FeedbackScore and FeedbackScore1 must be equal (duplicate column check)
rationale: Columns exhibit 81.25% value resemblance suggesting duplication; observed divergence (e.g., 2.87 vs 4.11) indicates data quality issues

rule: Full_Name must match the corresponding Name in Cust_Bio_dirty after standardizing casing and whitespace
rationale: S_N establishes one-to-one relationship; name fields should represent the same person across tables

check_params.semantic_check: Full_Name should match Name after standardizing casing and whitespace

rule: ID must exactly match ID_No in Cust_Bio_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: S_N joins the tables; identification numbers must be consistent across account and bio records

rule: Gender particles in Full_Name must be consistent with Gender in Cust_Bio_dirty: Bin/s/o indicates Male, Binte/d/o indicates Female
rationale: Malay (Bin/Binte) and Indian (s/o/d/o) naming conventions encode gender in patronymics which must match declared Gender

check_params.semantic_check: If Full_Name contains 'Bin' or 's/o' (case insensitive), Gender should be 'Male'; if contains 'Binte' or 'd/o', Gender should be 'Female'
